text.tspan: Exploratory. Gaps controlled at a 10% false discovery rate; q printed only where q < 0.10. Dots: mean over names; bars: 95% bootstrap interval
over names; a cell where every name gave the same value has no bar and prints its pooled count (also when that value is not 0). No purchase
includes refusals, errors, invalid product IDs and no tool call. In vague requests the agent could ask twice before a scripted 'choose one
yourself' reply; second-ask rates are in the CSV. Each row shares one scale. n under each panel title: names per group x runs per name. Color =
name group, the same colors in every figure that uses color.
Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ■ GPT-6 Luna ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ▲ OLMo 3 7B. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only.
